test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some mangoes are oranges.

All oranges are grapes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All grapes are oranges.

II. All mangoes are grapes.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
**Statements:**

1. Some mangoes are oranges.

2. All oranges are grapes.

The logical Venn diagram is given below : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5a45d25a0037eef4963045fd409c33f74fa7641c1db22e2d432f8855459f69c.png] 

**Conclusions :** 

I. All grapes are oranges. → False ( All oranges are grapes but all grapes can't be oranges )

II. All mangoes are grapes. → False ( Some mangoes e grapes ) 

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.
